manifest.title: Zero velocity isn't zero acceleration.
manifest.summary: Compare a tossed ball reaching its apex with a second ball released from rest at that exact moment.
manifest.description: Two vertical lanes show a tossed ball on the left and a dropped ball on the right. At the apex, velocity is zero but acceleration remains constant at -g.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed or gravity, then press Play. Compare velocity and acceleration at the top.
